```{r}
# read in and filter
readAirr <- function(sample_dir){
  df <- read.table(sample_dir, sep = '\t', header = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
  
  df <- df %>%
       dplyr::mutate(v_region_sequence = stringr::str_sub(toupper(sequence),
                    start = as.integer(v_sequence_start),
                    end = as.integer(v_sequence_end))) %>%
       filter(!is.na(c_call) & str_sub(c_call, 1, 3) == locus & !grepl("TTTTTTTTTTT", umi) & !grepl("N", junction) & !grepl("N", v_region_sequence)) %>%
       #filter(!grepl("N", v_region_sequence)) %>%
  return(df)
}

bcrs_list <- list("S1_ONT_Q17_BCR"=dir_2459_sd17_b, "S1_PB_Q17_BCR"=dir_2459_pb_b)
tcrs_list <- list("S1_ONT_Q17_TCR"=dir_2459_sd17_t, "S1_PB_Q17_TCR"=dir_2459_pb_t)

# combined bcrs
bcrs_sp <- lapply(bcrs_list, function(file_path) {
  list(airr_df = readAirr(file_path))
  })

#combined tcrs
tcrs_sp <- lapply(tcrs_list, function(file_path) {

  })
```

#Figure generation

figure function
```{r}
plot_knee <- function(df_airr, sample_label, chain_cols) {

  keep_loci <- c("IGH","IGK","IGL","TRA","TRB")

  df <- as_tibble(df_airr) %>%
    filter(consensus_count > 0, locus %in% keep_loci) %>%
    transmute(locus  = as.character(locus), group  = as.character(group), n_orig = as.numeric(n_orig)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(group), !is.na(n_orig))

  knee <- df %>%
    group_by(locus, group) %>%
    summarise(value = sum(n_orig), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(locus) %>%
    arrange(desc(value), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(rank = row_number(), n_rank = n()) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(pct = if_else(n_rank > 1, (rank - 1) / (n_rank - 1), 0))

  # number labels
  counts <- df %>%
    distinct(locus, group) %>%
    dplyr::count(locus, name = "n_groups") %>%
    mutate(locus = factor(locus, levels = keep_loci),
           label = paste0(as.character(locus), ": ", scales::comma(n_groups)))

  # anchor position in the right half of the figure
  label_df <- knee %>%
    filter(pct >= 0.005, pct <= 0.02, value > 1.6) %>%
    group_by(locus) %>%
    dplyr::slice_max(order_by = pct, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    left_join(counts, by = "locus")

  ggplot(knee, aes(x = pct, y = value, color = locus)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.55, alpha = 0.95) +
    scale_color_manual(values = chain_cols, breaks = keep_loci, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_log10(labels = label_number(accuracy = 1), breaks = log_breaks(n = 7)) +
    scale_x_continuous(trans  = pseudo_log_trans(sigma = 1e-4), limits = c(0, 1),
      breaks = c(0, 0.01, 0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1), labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
    labs(x = "Spatial sequence group size rank (%)", y = "Reads per UMI-SPBC group",color = NULL) +
    annotate("label", x = 0.0001, y = 10, label = sample_label, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, fill = "gray91", label.size = 0, size = 2.7) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = label_df, aes(label = label), inherit.aes = TRUE,
      color = "black", size = 2.6, direction = "y",hjust = 0,
      nudge_x = 1.4,                # push labels right
      segment.color = "black", segment.size = 0.3, box.padding = 0.15,
      force = 3,                     # stronger separation
      max.overlaps = Inf, min.segment.length = 0) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 7) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
      axis.text  = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 6.5, color = "black"),
      legend.text  = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
      panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.2),
      plot.margin = margin(2, 8, 2, 2),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA))
}
```

function to only extract the legend
```{r}
extract_legend <- function(p) {
  g <- ggplotGrob(p)
  idx <- which(sapply(g$grobs, function(x) x$name) == "guide-box")
  if (length(idx) == 0) return(grid::zeroGrob())
  g$grobs[[idx[1]]]
}
```


```{r, warning=FALSE}
#extract legend form one plot to add it later to the combined one

#pacbio sample (top)
p_pb  <- plot_knee(bt_sp$S1_PB_Q17$airr_df,  "S1_PB_Q17",  chain_cols)
leg <- extract_legend(p_pb + theme(legend.position = "bottom"))

p_pb <- p_pb + theme(
  axis.title.x = element_blank(),
  axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
  axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
  axis.title.y = element_blank(),
  plot.margin  = margin(t = 5, r = 5, b = 0, l = 0),
  legend.position = "none")

#ont sample (below)
p_ont <- plot_knee(bt_sp$S1_ONT_Q17$airr_df, "S1_ONT_Q17", chain_cols)
p_ont <- p_ont + theme(
  axis.title.y = element_blank(),
  plot.margin  = margin(t = 0, r = 5, b = 5, l = 0),
  legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
#add custom y-label
panels <- plot_grid(p_pb, p_ont, ncol = 1, align = "v", axis = "l", rel_heights = c(1, 1.15))

#shared y-label across both 
panels_with_ylabel <- plot_grid(
  ggdraw() + draw_label("Reads per UMI-SPBC group", angle = 90, size = 7),
  panels, ncol = 2, rel_widths = c(0.045, 1))
```

put together the final figure
```{r, fig.width=3.2, fig.height=4}
# center bottom legend (cant manipulate with margin bc its a 'separate' figure)
legend_centered <- ggdraw() +
  draw_grob(leg, x = 0.55, y = 0.5, width = 0.9, height = 1, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5)

p3_a <- plot_grid(panels_with_ylabel, legend_centered, ncol = 1,
  rel_heights = c(1, 0.06),label_size = 20, label_x = -0.02) + 
  theme(plot.margin  = margin(l = 5))

p3_a
```
